item.title: KOSS SB45 audio setup to IC-705
item.description: Icom IC-705 alows distinct setups for RX and TX on SSB, FM and other modes. When you connect a new headset with microphone, like in my case the KOSS SB-45, it’s interesting to adjust the audio setup. Here are my details.
